verdict.rationale: Ashby's ATS page claims you can 'design and develop your perfect recruiting process,' and the co-founder describes the product as built to be flexible and customizable first. This loosely implies configurable pipelines, and the Assistant references candidates' current stage and can update candidates. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates between stages, bulk actions across a pipeline, and any hands-on corroboration.
